GOVERNMENTS ABSOLUTELY SHOULD PENALIZE DELIBERATE PUBLIC DECEPTION, AS IT UNDERMINES INFORMED CHOICE AND FAIR MARKETS.

REFLEXIVE QUESTIONING OF ALL AUTHORITY CAN BE VALUABLE, BUT I THINK SOME DEFERENCE TO EXPERTISE AND LEGITIMATE INSTITUTIONS IS ALSO NECESSARY FOR FUNCTIONAL SOCIETIES.
